ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a global ratio of approximately 94:6, where high-intensity pixels are restricted to small focal spots and distal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous geometric blobs are concentrated at the far left and far right distal tips. The remainder of the fluke surface is a solid low-intensity field punctuated by sparse, localized high-intensity pixel coordinates (white dots) scattered across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximate 70-degree V-shaped central depression with a moderate vertical depth relative to the horizontal span of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations present along the entirety of the trailing edge. Noticeable larger-scale irregular valleys located approximately 30% from the median notch on the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge exhibits a consistent concave curvature from the median notch toward the distal tips, terminating in sharp upward-tapering points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense clusters of circular high-contrast pixel groups (barnacles) localized exclusively on the extreme distal tips of both lobes. Smaller, individual circular white scars visible on the central interior of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple fine, unaligned linear high-contrast disruptions visible; particularly a set of 3-4 parallel diagonal marks on the upper-mid section of the right lobe and a long horizontal scratch on the lower left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified biological colonization (barnacles) on the distal edges; minor irregular indentations along the trailing edge indicative of previous tissue loss or wear.
other_distinctive_markers: The extreme density and protrusion of barnacle clusters on the fluke tips create a unique 'crusted' silhouette not mirrored in the smoother median regions.
